# 612: Lær teknisk analyse med Christian Harto fra Investtech

**Feed**: pengepodden-no  
**Published**: 2026-09-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Educational Pengepodden episode (Norwegian) in which host Elsie Sundfør and guest Kristian Hartro, CEO of Investtech, explain quantitative technical analysis. They cover rising and falling trend channels, head-and-shoulders and double-top/bottom formations, support and resistance, why a high RSI has in their research worked as a buy signal rather than a sell signal, insider buying and avoiding volatile stocks. Investtech's algorithmic signals favour SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge and Nordic Semiconductor, while Envipco and Novo Nordisk are flagged as falling-trend stocks to stay away from; the guest also notes Investtech's small/mid-cap-tilted funds have lagged this year as large caps like Equinor led.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SB1NO — SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Best technical score on Oslo Børs (~90), rising trend near the top of the channel, heavy insider buying after a big rally.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Investtech) opinion: in their research, stocks in rising trends outperform the index by about 6.5 percentage points a year, and the higher a stock sits in its channel the better it tends to do afterwards. The stock has the top composite score on Oslo Børs, and insiders keep buying with their own money despite the big rise. This fits their 1–6 month horizon.

#### Sell Triggers

- head-and-shoulders or double-top formation appears
- break down through the floor of the rising trend channel
- insiders start selling
- volatility rises sharply

> *"Sparbank 1 Sør-Norge det er den aller beste aksjen i Oslo Børs, den har 90-80 skår"*

---

### 🟢 NOD — Nordic Semiconductor | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Price near support around 168 with resistance at 207 (~27% upside), broad rising trend and an insider purchase — a 'trading opportunity'.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Investtech) view: buying just above support with plenty of room up to resistance gives a good risk/reward. The stock is also in a broad rising trend and an insider has bought. Suggested approach: take a position near the 168 support, cut a small loss if it closes below, and watch whether it breaks through 207.

#### Sell Triggers

- close below support around 168
- fails at resistance around 207 and falls back
- break of the rising trend

> *"her er det en innside som også er kjøpt aksjen ligger nærme støtte da har vi noe som heter en handelsmulighet"*

---

### ⛔ ENVIP.OL — Envipco Holding | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Long falling trend; dropped ~10% on weak French deposit-machine numbers and broke its last support.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Investtech) view: their research shows stocks in falling trends keep falling and underperform the index, so they stay out. This holds even though fundamental analysts call Envipco a candidate to double. Recent weak French numbers pushed it through support. Investtech only buys after a bottom signal (inverse head-and-shoulders or double bottom) and a new rising trend.

#### Sell Triggers

- inverse head-and-shoulders or double-bottom signal
- stock enters a new rising trend

> *"aksjer i fallende trender skal man ikke kjøpe forskningen vår viser at aksjer som ligger i fallende trender, de fortsetter å falle og de faller mer enn indeks"*

---

### ⛔ NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Head-and-shoulders top late 2024 with a sell signal around 800; still in a falling long-term trend and further decline is indicated.

#### Reasoning

Guest (Investtech) view: the late-2024 head-and-shoulders gave a sell signal around 800 DKK and the stock fell to about 220. It has broken up through the ceiling of its falling channel, which only means a slower decline, and the long-term analysis has not turned. The host made a lucky trade from about 230 to 330 but agreed it is still in a falling trend.

#### Sell Triggers

- bottom formation (inverse head-and-shoulders or double bottom) appears
- long-term trend turns to rising

> *"nå er den fortsatt i en fallende trend, selv om den har brutt opp gjennom tak i den fallende trenden. Videre nedgang er egentlig indikert på lang sikt."*
